{"id": "7e1c93f8-b9c1-483e-bfe4-0547a87bf744", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "No — the `ListDistributions` call only gives you the summary `DistributionList` (ID, domain name, status, ARN, enabled flag, aliases, origins, etc.). It does **not** include the `Logging` block. That config detail only comes back from `GetDistributionConfig` or `GetDistribution`, which return the full `DistributionConfig` structure — and `Logging` (with its `Enabled`, `Bucket`, `Prefix`, `IncludeCookies` fields) lives inside that structure, not in the list summary.

So for an operational review, the right approach is:

1. `ListDistributions` to enumerate distribution IDs.
2. For each one, call `GetDistributionConfig` (or `GetDistribution`) and check `DistributionConfig.Logging.Enabled`.

If you want, I can pull the actual logging status for your distributions right now — just say the word and I'll check them against account 012345678901_1.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
